description: Read one model's benchmark result in full: its output (structured_output), the scoring breakdown (quality_detail: per-field scores, judge verdicts and the findings that update the reference) and its derived scores. include_runs=true adds every repetition with its own output and breakdown (can be large). result_id comes from get_benchmark_scenario or get_benchmark_scenario_results. No LLM call.

include_runs.description: Include every repetition's output and breakdown (can be large).
include_runs.title: Include Runs

result_id.description: UUID of the result (the `id` of a result row).
result_id.title: Result Id

name: get_benchmark_result
title: Get benchmark result
